subject: Moving y-axis labels to right of graph

messages.author: a2a30993d9ad7ee8
messages.subject: Moving y-axis labels to right of graph
parts:
I would like to move the y-axis labeling to the right side of the
following graph...for reasons that I hope are apparent.


library(ggplot2)
hr <- c(1/3,1/2,2/3,4/5)
hr <- sort(c(hr,1,1/hr))
nhr<- length(hr)
x <- data.frame(cbind(
Biomarker=c(array(0,nhr),array(1,nhr)),
HR = c(array(1,nhr),hr),
grp = c(1:nhr,1:nhr)))
y <- x[order(grp),]
qplot(data=y,x=Biomarker,y=HR,group=factor(grp),geom="line",log="y")

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Moving y-axis labels to right of graph
parts:
Hi:

This isn't the most elegant look I can think of, but it may be enough
to get you started:

qplot(data=y,x=Biomarker,y=HR,group=factor(grp),geom="line",log="y") +
geom_text(data = subset(y, Biomarker == 1L),
aes(label = grp), x = 1.1, size = 5) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), limits = c(0, 1.1))

Dennis
